label: Best months
quote: Best time to visit Ushu Forest: June to September

label: Access
value: A 4x4 jeep is needed from Kalam; the road is mostly a jeep track
quote: You must use a 4x4 jeep from Kalam.
source: Discover Swat, Mahodand Lake to Kalam jeep track guide

label: Jeep fare
value: Private return jeep from Kalam, about PKR 6,000 to 8,000
quote: Private return jeep from Kalam costs PKR 6,000 to 8,000.
source: Discover Swat, Mahodand Lake to Kalam jeep track guide

label: Winter
value: The track is closed from December to early April because of snow
quote: From December to early April the track is closed because of heavy snowfall.
source: Discover Swat, Mahodand Lake to Kalam jeep track guide
